payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
node.criteria: Compare the same visible region of the jacket’s front closure in SOURCE and EDITED. Determine whether corresponding closure cues are sufficiently visible in both images for a reliable comparison. If the edited view turns away from or obscures the closure, fulfillment is unobservable; do not infer closure or progress from pose, a swinging panel, or drape. When comparison is reliable, full achievement requires the front panels to meet along the closure with no visible opening. Partial achievement requires visible evidence that the panels have moved together along some portion of the closure while an opening remains. A visible opening without reliable corresponding comparison does not establish zero progress.
node.binding: Compare the jacket on the woman in SOURCE with the jacket on the woman in EDITED. Assess only corresponding front-closure cues that are reliably visible in both images; if the edited pose or garment obscures those cues, leave fulfillment unresolved. The requested endpoint remains a fully closed jacket; pose or garment movement alone is not closure progress.
node.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
node.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
node.zero_when: Reliable comparison of corresponding visible closure cues shows no movement of the front panels toward meeting along the closure. Do not assign zero when viewpoint, occlusion, or pose prevents reliable comparison, and do not use a swinging panel or changed drape as evidence of zero progress.
node.half_when: Reliable corresponding closure cues show that the front panels have moved together along part of the closure, but a visible opening remains. Pose or drape change alone is not partial fulfillment; if corresponding cues cannot be compared reliably, fulfillment is unresolved.
node.full_when: The front panels meet along the visible closure with no visible opening remaining. If the same closure region is not sufficiently visible to establish this reliably, fulfillment is unresolved rather than full.

node_traces.evidence: In SOURCE, the jacket’s front closure is visible from the front, but in EDITED she has turned sideways and the jacket panel swings outward, obscuring the corresponding closure cues. The changed pose and drape do not establish whether the panels moved together or whether the jacket is closed, so fulfillment is unobservable.
